title: The Cloud Bazaar
description: Run a balloon-hung stall on a floating market: read the demand forecast, buy four goods, serve three customers a day, keep fresh stock from losing value — and fund the voyage to a new island in ten days.
controls: Tap + / − to buy goods at the morning market
Tap + / − per order line to choose how many units to sell
Tap Sell or Turn away for each customer
Works with mouse, keyboard-free, and touch
credits: Concept: Cédric Bernadac, with AI agents
